---
title: "Troubleshooting"
---

| Problem | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `Read-only file system` or `permission denied` | You tried to write inside `course-material`. Write to your home folder, `~/pet_course`, instead. |
| The browser shows an error when you open an app | Check that the terminal says `Listening on`, and that you copied the whole link that the script printed, including the final `/`. |
| A bloodstream report has no figures or layout | You opened it in JupyterLab. Open it with `view_bloodstream.sh` instead, as in [part 3](03-bloodstream.qmd#run-a-default-analysis). |
| The plots in a PETFit report don't respond | Click **Trust HTML** at the top of the report. |
| ezBIDS says **Select Directory** requires Chrome or Edge, or it shows your laptop's files | You opened ezBIDS in your own browser or in Firefox. Close it, and start it with `open_ezbids.sh` in a terminal on the Desktop, as in [part 1](01-ezbids.qmd#open-ezbids). |
| A page says "Token authentication is enabled" | This browser isn't logged in. Open your full Neurodesk link, with `?token=`, in this browser first. |
| The terminal or the browser stops responding | The VPN may have dropped. Reconnect, and open your Neurodesk link again. Your files are kept. |
